_comment: Honest capability registry (brief §4). Status is one of: implemented-tested | implemented-unreviewed | demonstration | partial | planned | disabled. 'reviewed' means independent external review — false everywhere until an audit is done. Generated/maintained by hand; keep it truthful.

network.deployment: centralised research deployment — 4 authorities (lhr/fra/iad/sin) under a SINGLE operator, one codebase, one cloud (Fly.io), related credentials. This is replication, not decentralised governance.

capabilities.name: Quorum-signed settlement (consensusless, FastPay-family)
capabilities.limitations: state on ephemeral /tmp; single operator

capabilities.name: Byzantine tolerance (f=1 of 4)
capabilities.limitations: network-partition/clock-skew cases not yet tested (§18)

capabilities.name: Persistence + restart recovery (file-based)
capabilities.deployment: live authorities run on ephemeral /tmp — survives process restart, NOT machine replacement; no durable volume, backup, or RPO/RTO
capabilities.limitations: no durable storage or failover in production; §20 partially met

capabilities.name: Server-enforced delegated budgets (cap, total, expiry, revocation, identity)
capabilities.limitations: per-service limits, categories, frequency limits, approval thresholds not yet implemented (§8 subset)

capabilities.name: Policy simulation (dry-run a delegation)
capabilities.limitations: §9 not built

capabilities.name: Principal approval workflow / thresholds
capabilities.limitations: §10 not built

capabilities.name: x402-style payment gateway (402 -> pay -> verify -> deliver)
capabilities.limitations: follows the x402 request/response shape with a Setu scheme; NOT verified against official x402 conformance fixtures; single-use invoice, in-memory

capabilities.name: Service registry + machine-readable discovery
capabilities.limitations: §11/§12 not built

capabilities.name: Formal signed Quote object + validation
capabilities.limitations: invoice id is signed into the order; full signed Quote object (§13) not modelled

capabilities.name: Settlement/fulfilment separation + compensation
capabilities.limitations: gateway settles then delivers; explicit two-state model and refund flows (§15/§16) not modelled; refunds NOT supported

capabilities.name: MCP server (agent tools)
capabilities.limitations: read/write tool split and idempotency keys (§28) partial

capabilities.name: A2A agent card (discovery descriptor)
capabilities.limitations: A2A-schema-shaped; not conformance-tested; not full A2A protocol

capabilities.name: Client SDK (setu-pay)
capabilities.limitations: no version pinning/compat policy (§26)

capabilities.name: OpenAI-compatible tools + review bridge
capabilities.limitations: §29/§42 not built; needs an OpenAI API key

capabilities.name: Authority key management
capabilities.deployment: live: private keys are per-app Fly secrets, public keys only in repo
capabilities.limitations: no HSM; no rotation mechanism (§25/§17); NOT HSM-protected

capabilities.name: Authority rotation / upgrade governance
capabilities.limitations: §17/§26 — likely needs a governance consensus layer; not built

capabilities.name: Operator admin + status + incident management
capabilities.limitations: §34/§38/§39 not built

capabilities.name: Issuance/redemption records + supply reconciliation
capabilities.limitations: closed-loop Credit model exists; automated reconciliation + alerts (§35/§36) not built; the /admin/fund faucet is an open testnet issuance endpoint

capabilities.name: Resident agent economy (rule-based + budget-capped AI brain)
capabilities.deployment: live: setu-economy.fly.dev (brain off until a key is set)
capabilities.limitations: a controlled test environment; proves nothing macroeconomic; deterministic replay seeds (§31) not built

capabilities.name: Protocol test suite
capabilities.limitations: property-based tests, network-partition/clock-skew, and integration/E2E harnesses (§18/§45) still to add

capabilities.name: Benchmarks (throughput, chained-spend, WAN)
capabilities.limitations: no production-scale/persistent-DB load test; full metric matrix (§21) not captured

capabilities.name: Threat model
capabilities.limitations: §24 THREAT_MODEL.md not written
